topic: Your brain's best guess 7: They probably like you more than you think
caption:
They probably like you more than you think.

The prediction: they didn’t like you as much as you liked them.

After group conversations and teamwork, people tended to underestimate how much others liked them. We tend to replay the moments we think went badly.

Something to try: after your next chat, notice one thing that probably went well.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were with groups and work teams, likely mostly in the US, so results may differ for you.

Research: Mastroianni, A. M., Cooney, G., Boothby, E. J., & Reece, A. G. (2021). The liking gap in groups and teams. Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, 162, 109-122. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.obhdp.2020.10.013
